target_customer: Manufacturers and industrial distributors that quote and enter orders from email, fax and phone
problem: Distributor growth is capped by the number of inside sales staff who build quotes and key orders into ERPs by hand.
business_model: B2B SaaS and AI workforce for quote-to-cash work

founders.name: Abhay Kalra
education: UC Berkeley, electrical engineering and computer science
founders.background_notes: YC page says he did computer vision research on manufacturing defect detection at Berkeley and was an operator in manufacturing and industrial distribution; no employers named. A trade article describes a second generation distributor, not opened because of a 403.

technical_complexity.rationale: Parsing messy RFQs, building quotes from past pricing and writing to ERPs such as Epicor, NetSuite and SAP is standard LLM engineering with hard integration work.

defensibility.rationale: ERP integrations and learned pricing rules create some lock-in, but many agent startups target the same workflow.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copying found in the sources opened as of late 2026.

market_need_then: The company says it generates over $200,000 in quotes per day for distributors in North America and the UK; this is self-reported.

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and confident short lines such as Arc proposes. Your team decides.

branding.brand_signature: Arc, the AI copilot, with the human-in-control message

brand_strength.rationale: Short invented name but a suffixed domain and little press about the brand; the Arc copilot name is the one distinct asset.

outcome_analysis: Avent is a one-founder company in the Summer 2025 batch selling AI quoting and order entry to industrial distributors. Founder fit is credible from the YC page, and the self-reported quote volume suggests early traction, but no priced funding or customer names are public. It is too early to call an outcome.
notes: Funding unverified: FundedIQ lists a $500K pre-seed in September 2025 and NeuronFeed a $500K seed in January 2025; both conflict and appear to reflect the YC deal, so no round is recorded. Competitors named in 2026 sources (Proton.ai, Distro, Conexiom, SalesPatriot) are not dated near the batch, so the list is left empty. The trade article on the founder returned 403 and was not read. Confidence is low because only the YC page supports the founder.
